name: Haritha Vijay Vihar Restaurant
signature_dish: Veg buffet lunch with a Nagarjuna Sagar lake view
why_it_matters: The genuine Telangana-side anchor at Nagarjuna Sagar — the restaurant at the state tourism corporation's Haritha Vijay Vihar resort in Hill Colony, Nandikonda. Close to the dam, the Anupu Buddhist remains and the boat jetty for Nagarjunakonda island, it is the dependable, lake-view meal on the Telangana bank in an area thin on dining.
insider_tip: The veg buffet lunch runs until 3pm; dinner is a limited à la carte menu, so time a midday meal here. Book a lake-view table. This is the reliable choice on the Telangana side — most other dining is roadside dhabas.
signature_address: TGTDC Haritha Vijay Vihar, Hill Colony, Nandikonda, Nagarjuna Sagar, Nalgonda District, Telangana 508202

name: Hotel Siddartha
why_it_matters: One of the most sought-after restaurants in Nagarjuna Sagar — a Hill Colony multi-cuisine eatery near Buddhavanam, particularly known for its biryani. Roughly 15 minutes from the dam, it is the go-to sit-down option for visitors who want a proper meal off the resort.
insider_tip: The biryani is the dish to order; the kitchen also turns out South Indian meals and seafood. Open 9.30am-10pm, so it covers an early start or a late return from Ethipothala Falls. Walk-in.
signature_address: Buddhavanam Hill Colony, near Dupthavanam, Nandikonda, Nagarjuna Sagar, Nalgonda District, Telangana 508202

name: Park Inn Restaurant
why_it_matters: The in-house restaurant of Park Inn Hotel in Hill Colony — a steady multi-cuisine option in the small Nagarjuna Sagar dining cluster. With breakfast service and a full menu, it is a practical meal stop for travellers staying on the Telangana side of the dam.
insider_tip: Handy for breakfast before an early dam-and-island visit. Standard veg-and-non-veg menu; portions are generous for the price. Walk-in.
signature_address: Park Inn Hotel, Hill Colony, Nagarjuna Sagar, Nalgonda District, Telangana 508202

name: Hotel Tiger Valley Restaurant
signature_dish: Spicy Andhra-style meals near the dam
why_it_matters: A restaurant-with-rooms property close to the Nagarjuna Sagar Dam — one of the few eateries actually near the dam itself rather than up in Hill Colony. A convenient stop for a meal between the dam viewpoint and Ethipothala Falls.
insider_tip: The food runs to the spicier Andhra end — say so if you want it toned down. Its position near the dam makes it the practical lunch halt on a day-trip loop. Walk-in.
signature_address: Near Nagarjuna Sagar Dam, Nagarjuna Sagar, Nalgonda District, Telangana 508202

name: Ethipothala Falls Tourism Restaurant & Tea Stalls
signature_dish: Basic South Indian meals and snacks at the falls
why_it_matters: Ethipothala Falls — about 14-18km from the dam — has almost no dining: a tourism-developed restaurant with garden facilities at the site, plus a small tea stall. It is the only food at one of the area's main sights, so it counts despite its limits.
insider_tip: Carry your own food if you want a real meal — the falls genuinely have minimal options. The tourism restaurant covers basic veg meals and the tea stall handles snacks. At the falls parking, expect a small monkey-watch fee for your car.
signature_address: Ethipothala Falls viewpoint, Nagarjuna Sagar, Nalgonda District, Telangana 508202
